purpose: Record coarse visible tachometer ranges before attempting any audio-to-RPM mapping; independent work while the current idle audio awaits listening.
source: Approved F3; reuse existing native-resolution JPEGs and original PTS from state_media_v1/F3_context1, checking each recorded hash and original muxed-video hash. No new download or media search.
display: Native pixels only; lossless PNG crops from the existing decoded JPEGs, no resize, sharpening, interpolation, thresholding or automatic needle detector. Keep the original full frame alongside each crop.
annotation: Assistant visual reading, not independent human telemetry. Record displayed gear and speed plus an enclosing RPM bracket based on the printed major 1000-RPM marks. If a needle is near a mark or visibly transitional use a wider bracket or unknown; no sub-tick precise RPM estimate.
audit: Recheck all raw/input hashes, exact PTS against the original extraction log, all crop RGB pixels against the full decoded image, table/frame bindings and all619C-H/67originalvoices. Annotation truth is not established by an image hash or numerical audit.
interpretation: Sampled display only, not continuous RPM, physical shift time, engine-order assignment, pedal/load/fuel telemetry or calibrated audiovisual synchronization. Do not interpolate between samples or apply F3 cabin RPM labels to F2 idle or A exterior.
next: Use qualified simultaneous display/audio evidence for future constrained pitch study; preserve original phase-extractor qualification gates. Pending idle allocation audition remains the next sound decision, not a C promotion.
